packaged_workflow_scope: 36 checks ran against the exact installed build60 collector using disposable local data, accounts disabled and browser checks skipped. These are supporting checks, separate from the live desktop workflows.
signing: Developer ID signed with secure timestamps and hardened runtime. Strict signatures, Gatekeeper assessments, stapled tickets and exact ZIP/DMG readback passed.
changes_since_build56: Keep the learned usage retry floor after a successful retry. Healthy slower polling displays the original reading age and next check; failed or overdue checks and expired reset windows are stale.

Verify an idle Claude project thread from bounded newest-first reply pages, with stable thread-state checks on every page and a final confirmation. Old system notices cannot hide the latest authored reply.
Retry a rejected native notification briefly while its exact event is still eligible. Reviewed, replaced, expired or disabled notifications are not retried.
Fence saved account-chat attention and notification eligibility by the current verified account while preserving saved identity and review history.

Treat missing Claude activity fields as an incomplete response, including a partly incomplete catalog. Preserve only the same account's prior receipt with its original 15-second expiry and normal retry cadence; never turn omitted status into an empty account or a completion.

Reserve verification work for recent Codex histories on every poll. Rotate recent and older histories independently, reserving one eighth of the unchanged shared time and byte budget for older work. Keep prefix, rewrite, identity and completion checks intact.
Show the running app version and build in About. Refer to the build receipt and source manifest for the current release instead of embedding a stale build number in README.

limitations: Claude may omit current activity metadata. The last complete reading is usable only until its original 15-second expiry; longer gaps show unavailable status until a complete response arrives. Saved identities and review state remain local, but current status and catalog-only visibility are not guaranteed during an outage.
The stronger consistency query does not eliminate Claude's sparse activity responses. Missing fields are not treated as unchanged or idle.

The build60 live Codex test had two isolated verification intervals and a six-second initial catch-up after restart. The sustained alternating backlog defect did not recur during the remaining observation window. This bounded test is not a guarantee for all history sizes or future provider changes.

A continuously changing transcript that cannot be fully verified within the bounded work allowance can remain unconfirmed. The scheduler does not bypass prefix or rewrite verification or retain an unverified Cooking state indefinitely.
The ChatGPT desktop Cooking phase was not observed in the user-submitted build 56 test; only its completion was confirmed. No fresh provider web lifecycle was run for 59 or 60.

The final release installed and launched on macOS 13.0. VM provider accounts were unconnected; connected-provider workflows and visible notification delivery remain unverified there. A host banner was confirmed by the user on build56; this is not a new build60 banner confirmation.

Provider account readers require the corresponding existing sign-in on this Mac and use interfaces that can change. Errors, rate limits and delayed settlement metadata can delay activity or usage updates.

Account discovery is bounded to 100 recent conversations per provider. ChatGPT status work is bounded to 256 identities and latest-turn responses to 3 MiB. A first-seen reply that began before monitoring may remain unconfirmed without a finish timestamp or prior baseline.
This direct Mac distribution is separate from the historical App Store candidate and does not establish App Store approval.
release_assessment: Validated direct-distribution release with the limitations recorded here. The reported regressions have general fixes and automated coverage; final installed desktop and minimum-OS update checks are recorded separately from fixtures and earlier-build evidence.
publication_scope: Only the 200 allowlisted application source files, source manifest, finalized build receipt, sanitized distribution receipt and exact signed ZIP/DMG. No live databases, account credentials, private chat identifiers or titles, raw logs, screenshots, diagnostic scripts or private repository history.
